reason: SHARED-SHA256-BUNDLE-1. Original-authorship guest-safe SHA-256 and HMAC-SHA256 module. No third-party source, package, or code was copied into it: the SHA-256 core is the estate's own pure-JS construction already shipped in art-199/200/206/210/280/584/620 and _dtree.bundle.mjs (lifted and tightened here, with the 64-bit length written from two 32-bit halves instead of BigInt), implementing the public FIPS 180-4 algorithm; the HMAC wrapper is the public RFC 2104 construction written for this row; the UTF-8 encoder is the estate's validated ART595-ART590-UTF8-FIX-1 encoder. Named `_sha256.bundle.mjs` because ACCT-INFRA-KERNELS-BUILD-SPEC.md Sec.4.1 mandates the shipped `_detmath.bundle.mjs` filename shape for any shared, inline-consumed kernel bundle (the RISC0 guest provides only `_hash`, so a bundle import is unavailable in-guest), independent of authorship. Verified against node:crypto, NIST FIPS 180-4 example messages and RFC 4231 test cases 1 to 7 in the art-751 property floor.
